title: Refractive index value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be n = √7/2.

title: PC distance value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be PC = (√3 - 1)a/2.

title: Snell's Law at M
description: Important: Correctly applies Snell's Law at the entry point M, relating sin(60°) to n and the refraction angle θ.

title: Critical angle condition at N
description: Important: Correctly identifies that total internal reflection at N requires the angle of incidence to equal the critical angle, relating it to n and the geometry (90° - θ).

title: Geometry for BN and NC
description: Important: Uses the refraction angle θ and triangle geometry (e.g., tan θ = MB/BN) to find segment lengths BN and NC on side BC.

title: Geometry for PC
description: Important: Correctly uses the geometry of the exit path (e.g., triangle NPC) and the angle θ to derive the final distance PC.

title: Simultaneous equation solving
description: Optional: Shows clear algebraic manipulation to solve the system of equations from Snell's Law and the critical angle condition for n and θ.

title: Sign or angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly identifies the angle of incidence for total internal reflection at N (e.g., using θ instead of 90° - θ).

title: Unit or factor error
description: Pitfall: Omits the side length 'a' in the final expression for PC or makes an algebraic error in the geometric proportions.
